bilder.prompt:
Jerusalem at the Passover festival, a few pale city walls and houses hinted at. A crowd of pilgrims, men, women and children, look towards Jesus with eager, glad faces; some point to him. Jesus stands a little apart from them on the RIGHT, friendly but earnest and reserved, with clear space between him and the crowd. Wide shot.

PEOPLE AND OBJECTS (keep exactly):
- Jewish people of Jerusalem: men, women and children of different ages in everyday robes in sand, grey, blue-grey and white, some men with simple white prayer shawls; dignified and varied, never caricatured or stereotyped.
- Jesus: a Galilean man in his early thirties, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair, short full dark beard, warm brown eyes, olive skin, a kind and open face that is always fully visible like everyone else's; cream linen tunic and a muted terracotta-red mantle over one shoulder. No halo. He is the only person wearing terracotta-red.

PICTURE: Landscape picture, a single scene (not a comic page, no panel borders, no frame). There is no lettering of any kind and no speech bubbles in the picture. Keep the upper part of the picture above the heads as calm, nearly empty pale wash, because speech bubbles are added there later.

STYLE: Minimalist watercolour comic illustration for adults: warm white paper with lots of empty white space; very few thin, slightly irregular, deliberately broken ink lines, contours only where they clarify the form; diffuse, transparent watercolour washes with soft edges and visible paper; small warm muted palette of sand, ochre, terracotta, blue-grey, olive and soft ink grey; natural adult proportions and faces with restrained expressions, emotion shown through gaze, posture and gesture; backgrounds only hinted. No stone textures, no detailed folds, no decorative hatching, no glossy or cinematic light, no photorealism, no anime eyes. Historically plausible first-century Galilee and Judea: simple woven garments, sandals, earthenware, stone. Light only from daylight or small clay oil lamps.

The first attached image shows the drawing style (use only its style). The second attached image is the character sheet: draw every person exactly as there (face, hair, beard, age, clothing colours).

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTION FOR THIS RUN: The crowd consists only of ordinary Jerusalem pilgrims: no flower wreaths, nobody in violet or olive-green robes, none of the wedding people from the character sheet; only Jesus is taken from the character sheet.
